title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems Announces Hyundai Motor Group as Investor in $1B Raise
detail: Commonwealth Fusion Systems announced on September 10, 2026 that Hyundai Motor Group participated as an investor in CFS's previously announced $1 billion fundraise (closed July 30, 2026), the largest single funding round in fusion industry history since CFS's own $1.8B Series B in 2021. Hyundai's specific commitment was not disclosed. The companies said they will explore collaboration opportunities on future ARC power plant development, with Hyundai contributing industrial, engineering, and infrastructure expertise, and the partnership is expected to support fusion energy advancement in Korea under the country's '7 SEED' initiative. Hyundai joins a roster of Asia-Pacific investors in CFS including Woori Venture Partners (Korea), a Japanese consortium led by Mitsui & Co. and Mitsubishi Corporation, Temasek (Singapore), and Hostplus (Australia). CFS has now raised $4B total since its 2018 founding — roughly 30% of all private fusion investment globally.

title: RTX Ventures Invests in Xcimer Energy, Teams Up on Laser Directed-Energy Defense Tech
detail: RTX Ventures, the venture arm of defense contractor RTX, announced on September 10, 2026 a minority investment in laser-fusion company Xcimer Energy alongside a teaming agreement to explore integrating Xcimer's multi-kilojoule-class pulsed-laser technology into RTX directed-energy defense systems aimed at destroying drones, missiles, and other airborne threats. Xcimer's excimer laser platform — the basis for its DOE-approved Athena fusion power plant design (approved June 10, 2026) — shares core engineering challenges with laser weapons: firing pulses repeatedly, reliably, and affordably at scale. Xcimer has raised roughly $200M to date from investors including Hedosophia and Breakthrough Energy Ventures, and is targeting grid fusion power in the mid-2030s. The investment amount was not disclosed.

media.caption: Fusion power startups find new partners in the defense world
